sentences.ar: باسبارتو صحي بالمركب وهو ما بيعرف شو صار.
sentences.en: Passepartout woke up on the ship not knowing what had happened.

sentences.ar: وصل يوكوهاما وما كان معه ولا قرش.
sentences.en: He reached Yokohama without a single coin.
He had to work in a circus to be able to eat.

sentences.ar: بالصدفة، فوغ وعودا كانوا عم يتفرجوا على نفس السيرك.
sentences.en: By chance, Fogg and Aouda were watching the same circus.

sentences.ar: لما شاف باسبارتو سيده، فرح كتير وركض عليه.
sentences.en: When Passepartout saw his master, he was so happy and ran to him.

sentences.ar: فوغ كان مبسوط إنه لقاه سالم.
sentences.en: Fogg was glad he found him safe.

sentences.ar: طلعوا كلهم سوا من جديد، ومعهم فيكس.
sentences.en: They all set off together again, with Fix along.
They boarded a big ship toward America.

sentences.ar: باسبارتو حكى لفوغ كل الي صار معه.
sentences.en: Passepartout told Fogg everything that had happened to him.

sentences.ar: بس ما حكى إشي عن شكوكه بفيكس لهلق.
sentences.en: But he said nothing about his suspicions of Fix yet.
